training_seed_exclusion.reason: The expert proposed pickup, which is outside the student's allowed action set {left, right, forward}.

repetition_diagnostic_definitions.repeated_policy_input: Step t in an episode where sha256[:16] of the 247-d float32 feature vector equals an earlier step k < t in the same episode.
repetition_diagnostic_definitions.repeated_raw_observation: Step t in an episode where sha256[:16] of (obs['image'].tobytes() + obs['mission'].encode('utf-8')) equals an earlier step k < t in the same episode.
repetition_diagnostic_definitions.repeated_pose: Step t in an episode where true (agent_pos[0], agent_pos[1], agent_dir) equals an earlier step k < t in the same episode.
repetition_diagnostic_definitions.consecutive_blocked_forward: Contiguous run of >= 2 steps where front_blocked == True and chosen_action == 2 (forward).
repetition_diagnostic_definitions.recurring_multistep_cycle: Revisit of a previously visited true (agent_pos[0], agent_pos[1], agent_dir) pose at step t after first visit at step k < t with cycle_length = t - k (distinguishing length 1, length 2, and length >= 3; under static GoToLocal grid and deterministic argmax over current obs, pose revisit yields exact periodic state/action recurrence).
repetition_diagnostic_definitions.observation_alias_without_pose_repeat: Repeated policy input at a pose not yet visited in the episode.
